relations.subject: Hsing Yun
relations.evidence: In 1938 he entered the monastic life at the age of 12, ordaining as a novice at Qixia Temple under Zhikai, where he received the novice name Jinjue.

relations.subject: Hsing Yun
relations.evidence: He received the upasampadā vinaya precepts under Ruoshun at the same temple in 1941 and received the dharma name Wuche.

relations.subject: Hsing Yun
relations.evidence: Hsing Yun was first inspired by Buddhist modernism in 1945 while studying at Jiaoshan Buddhist College.

relations.subject: Hsing Yun
relations.evidence: There he learned about Buddhist teacher Taixu's calls for reform in Buddhism and the Sangha.

relations.subject: Hsing Yun
relations.object: Fo Guang Shan Buddhist monastic order
relations.evidence: He was the founder of the Fo Guang Shan Buddhist monastic order

relations.subject: Hsing Yun
relations.evidence: Following his resignation, Hsing Yun founded the Buddha's Light International Association (BLIA) as a layperson based Humanistic Buddhist organization.

relations.subject: Hsing Yun
relations.evidence: Hsing Yun himself was the abbot of the order until his resignation in 1985.
